steps: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves
Add diced onions and potatoes, sauté until soft
Add remaining vegetables, cook for 2-3 minutes
Add poha, mix well and cook for 2 minutes
Season with salt and serve hot
Soak rice and urad dal for 4-6 hours
Grind to a smooth paste without adding too much water
Heat a non-stick pan/tawa, pour batter thinly
Spread vegetables on top before it sets
Cook until golden, flip and cook other side
Soak green moong and rice for 2-3 hours
Heat oil, add onion, ginger, garlic paste
Cook until soft, blend into smooth puree
Return to pot, add salt and pepper
Garnish with coriander and serve hot
Add sliced ginger and mint leaves
Can add lemon juice if desired
Strain and drink warm before bed

ingredients: 1 chamomile tea bag or 1 tsp dried chamomile
steps: Add chamomile tea bag or star anise
Extract the water in a glass
Scoop out the soft malai with a spoon
Mix malai with the coconut water

ingredients: Green/peppermint tea (1 bag or 1 tsp leaves)
steps: Eat rajgira flakes separately as dry snack or with milk alternative

ingredients: Mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrot, zucchini, bell pepper)
steps: Steam vegetables for 10-12 minutes until tender-crisp
Drizzle with olive oil, add salt and pepper
Add ginger pieces, simmer for 3-4 minutes
Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and ginger
Add rice and moong dal, roast for 1 minute
Add 2 cups water, turmeric, and salt
Cook on high heat until boiling
Reduce heat and simmer until cooked (15-20 mins)
Serve with buttermilk flavored with jeera powder
Drain and dry on a cloth
Roast in a pan on medium heat until crispy
Add salt and store in an airtight container
